newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures finish barely mixed.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures finish barely mixed.

text.p: Oct 10 - IMM currency futures ended barely mixed. Trade picked up after midday as T-bond futures slid more on jitters about Friday's Sept U.S. PPI that some feared could gain more than 0.3-pct rise expected. Core seen up 0.2 pct. Currencies firmed as T-bonds fell but lacked upside followthrough. Dec Can dollar hit highest since Oct 1995 on technicals, Can budget optimism. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
